name: uams-web/uamswp-block-remover
description: Development tooling for UAMSWP Block Remover

scripts-descriptions.stan: Install the Integration suite's Composer setup (PHPStan scans its WordPress test classes), then run PHPStan.
scripts-descriptions.setup:integration: Install the Integration suite's own Composer setup (PHPUnit 9.6, wp-phpunit, the polyfills).
scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites, each in its own process, so the Unit suite never sees WordPress.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.mutate: Run mutation testing over the plugin source with the Unit suite (needs PCOV or Xdebug).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the PHPUnit 9.6 suite that boots WordPress through wp-phpunit against the test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:multisite: Run the PHPUnit 9.6 suite that boots a WordPress network through wp-phpunit against the test database.
